scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run db:setup --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client && npm run db:setup --prefix server
